kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.sebab.hi: an insult at the tea house
Sideways looks across the room, a "Hmph." It may pass, or it may heat up.
A shouting match in public, fingers pointing, townsfolk turning. It ends in an apology, a challenge or a grudge.
A sword duel in an arena, a square or a gate, stopped at 10 %%. The loser may accept it, or burn.
Two to four disciples a side; the two strongest pairs fight at once, the rest cheer.
Their gang waits on the road. The next journey may escape, be hurt, or be captured.
The elders of both sides meet: an apology, compensation, or a vow of revenge.
Word reaches their sect master; the standing with that sect falls (at most 20 a week).
The sect master acts in his own way: an official tournament challenge, an envoy of peace, or war when allowed.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.asal.kaw: Left their sect for the love of a disciple of this hall.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.dam: Send a letter of peace. Chance 50 %% + standing/2 + 10 %% when your realm is above their master's. Success: heat −40, standing +3; failure: heat −10.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.utu: A free elder goes to their sect for a day. Success: an apology or compensation; failure: home humiliated, heat +10.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.huk: Heat −25, standing +3. The disciple is punished and keeps a bitter memory; unjust when it was the victim.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.tun: Only when they were wrong. Chance 40 %% + 10 %% per hall level above their tier: 20 × tier NB to the victim's purse; failure: standing −5, heat +15.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.duk: You stand as the honour duel's challenger; your disciple fights braver. It starts when you are near.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.tan: From T5, at their gate or in a town: a sword duel with their Young Elder or Eldest Senior (10 %%, 3 minutes).
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.lar: You forbid the matter: its heat freezes. Press again to lift it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.bia: The disciples settle it themselves. If yours is the victim and it reaches T4 without you acting, it feels neglected.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.res: With a standing of −10 or more both sects make peace through them (standing +15, a pact offered); below it they elope.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.aksi.pis: They part. A lasting bittersweet memory; your disciple turns back to its cultivation.

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.harian.m: At the tea house %3$s, %1$s of %2$s laughed at our sect. I could not stay silent.
A cup broke at the tea house %3$s. %1$s (%2$s) thinks we are a small sect to be trampled.
The words of %1$s of %2$s still ring in my ears. One day they will be swallowed back.
The treasure appeared before us both. %1$s of %2$s snatched at it roughly.
%1$s (%2$s) and I both reached for it. Neither would give way.
Our guild mission was spoiled by %1$s of %2$s. On purpose, I am sure.
%1$s (%2$s) took the same mission, then handed in our work as theirs.
The defeat by %1$s (%2$s) on that stage haunts me.
They cheered for %1$s of %2$s. Next time, the cheers are mine.
It turns out %1$s of %2$s cares for the same person.
I saw %1$s (%2$s) give flowers. My chest burned.
That scroll! I chased %1$s of %2$s to the end of the road.
Someone accused me of stealing from %1$s (%2$s). Let them; they cannot prove it.
%1$s of %2$s squeezed an old merchant at the market %3$s. I stepped forward.
The merchant trembled before %1$s (%2$s). I could not pretend not to see.
Disciples of %2$s were squeezing the village. I stood before the villagers facing %1$s.
The village children hid behind me when %1$s (%2$s) came.
The sect %2$s struck at us again. %1$s was among them; I remember that face.

The crowd cheered when %1$s (%2$s) raised a hand in surrender.
The honour duel is won. %1$s of %2$s bowed, and I bowed back.
I lost to %1$s (%2$s). My arm still shakes as I write this.
This is not over, %1$s. The sect %2$s will hear my name again.

From today we are no longer enemies, %1$s (%2$s) and I.
%1$s of %2$s: a true rival. Next season we meet again on the stage.
I respect %1$s (%2$s). That is why I must grow stronger.
I keep this grudge in my chest. %1$s (%2$s), just wait.

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.harian.t: %1$s (%2$s) and I glared at each other. Luckily nobody started it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.harian.k: Our sects are enemies, but when %1$s of %2$s smiles I forget everything.
Though our sects are enemies... I still choose you, %1$s.
Night-market lanterns, %1$s's hand in mine. No one may know.
We met in secret again. %1$s brought me a red string.
%1$s left %2$s for me. Now we are in the same hall.
The master asked us to part. I obeyed, but my heart stayed with %1$s.
The master blessed %1$s and me. Two sects sat at one table because of us (%2$s).

They bound me. %1$s (%2$s) laughed. Master, help me...

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.h: The best table for a petty sect's disciple? Waiter, a new cup!
I paid for this tea with my own sweat.
A lowly disciple's sweat stinks. Out, or I throw you out!
Look at that shabby robe. Can't your sect afford cloth?
My robe is shabby, but my sword is sharp.
Sharp? Prove it outside, if you dare!
Oops, your cup spilled. My hands are slippery today.
Your hands are slippery, your tongue more so.
Careful. A mouth like that can lose its teeth.
That herb is ours. We saw it first.
I picked it. You only watched.
Then we settle it the cultivators' way!
That treasure's light is not for a petty disciple's eyes.
Heaven does not ask your sect when it grants a treasure.
If Heaven is silent, my sword will answer.
Put down that spirit stone and you walk home on both legs.
Your threat weighs less than this stone.
I'll make you regret ever touching it!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.g: We took this mission. Find other work, kid.
The guild seal on my paper is as valid as yours.
We'll see who comes home with the reward.
I wiped out the beast's tracks. Enjoy getting lost!
So you're the one who wrecked my trap!
Prove it. At the guild, the strong are right.
We'll hand in the beast's head. You just get tired.
I cut it down. Don't steal my merit.
Merit? You don't even know how to skin it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.t: Your win on that stage was pure luck.
Luck didn't throw you off the lei tai.
Next time no referee will save you.
You shamed me before my whole sect!
Your own pride shamed you.
Remember my face. I will collect on that defeat.
The judges favoured you. Everyone knows it.
Everyone saw your sword fall first.
Once more, no judges, no sect rules!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.a: Stay away from them. They're far above the likes of you.
Let them choose for themselves, not you.
Then let the sword show who is worthy.
The flower you gave? I threw it in the river.
You're jealous, and jealousy makes you ugly.
Mind your tongue, or I'll shame you in front of them!
This festival is no place to court our disciples.
Since when does a smile need your sect's permission?
Since today. Leave, or I drag you out!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.g: This scroll belongs to our sect now. Accept it.
My master's technique is not loot!
Take it back, if you can.
Your bag was open. Blame your own carelessness.
Theft is theft, whatever the excuse!
Call your master. I'd like to see him weep.
You guard even a technique this crude? Funny.
Give it back and I won't report you.
Report it. Our sect does not fear yours.
Our sect's scroll is in your bag. Don't pretend!
It fell on the road. Finders keepers.
A thief is a thief. You will pay for it!
I saw your hand, little thief.
Your eyes deceive you. Check your friends' bags.
Your master will be ashamed of you!
Our secret art is not for your filthy hands!
A technique that fine shouldn't gather dust.
Return it now, or blood will speak!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.p: This merchant owes our sect protection money.
The only danger in this market is you.
A little hero, is it? Let's see your nerve.
Step aside, junior. This is no business for a novice.
Robbing small traders, is that what your sect teaches?
My sect teaches: the weak bow. Care to learn?
One silver piece, or your stall becomes firewood.
Touch that stall and you deal with me.
Good. I was itching to stretch my arms.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.d: This village is under our protection. Protection isn't free.
Protection? You only rob them.
Insolent brat! You'll regret meddling.
Half of this year's harvest goes to our sect, understood?
These villagers are not your sect's slaves!
Then you can pay with your bones.
This old man pays too slowly. He needs a lesson.
Take your hands off him, right now!
You dare order me? In front of the villagers?
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.p: I hear your sect still licks its wounds from the other day.
Our sect rises faster than you think.
Then let's start again, right here.
My seniors taught your sect a lesson. You're next.
We'll return that lesson twice over.
I'm waiting. Don't take too long.
Your sect's banner is nice... as a doormat.
Insult me all you like, but not my sect!
Then defend your sect with your sword!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.r: Forgive me if I offended. I'm not looking for trouble.
Brother, we're both cultivators. There's no need for this.
I'll go. But please, leave the others alone.
If I wronged you, I apologise. Let's settle this kindly.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.t: Hmph. A petty sect's disciple.
Don't look at me like that.
Tch. Smells like a lowly sect.
Hmph. We'll see.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.p: Protection money. Now, before I lose my patience.
Nice stall. Shame if it burned, no?
Our sect is hungry. Empty your purse.
Don't play poor. I can hear your coins jingle.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.l: Let them go! Face me instead!
Step back. Let me talk to them.
Common folk are not your prey!
If you want to rob them, get past me first!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.c: Hey! Your hand is in my bag!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.d: Up on the stage. Let the swords speak!
I accept your hatred. Now accept my challenge!
An honour duel, until one of us yields!
The witnesses are here. Don't run!
Challenge accepted. Don't regret it.
I've been waiting for this.
My master taught me: never refuse a fair challenge.
Fine. One stroke for every insult.
Remember this day.
Your sword is still too young.
Go home and train ten more years.
I win today. Next time, don't look for trouble.
This isn't over!
I... was careless. That's all.
You got lucky this time.
Remember: I'll come back stronger.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.t: A petty sect's master dares challenge me? Interesting.
Your disciple is insolent. Let's see the master.
One stroke, and you will understand.
Very well. I'll teach you both at once.
Brothers, get them!
Attack! No mercy!
Show them our sect's strength!
Don't let a single one escape!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.s: This road belongs to our sect.
Pay the toll, or turn back.
We've been waiting for you, petty disciple.
See this banner? Here, we are the law.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.p: So this is their master? Not much to see.
Want to pass? Beat us first.
You can't protect your disciples on the road.
Go home, Master. This road isn't yours.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.m: I lost my temper. Forgive me.
I have shamed my sect. I'm sorry.
It was my fault. It won't happen again.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.s: I swear I will repay this!
By Heaven and Earth, I will collect this debt!
Remember my name. One day, you will kneel.
This blood won't dry until I have my revenge!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.d: This isn't over. Not yet.
You win today. Tomorrow, we'll see.
I will never forget.
Save your smile. You'll need it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.l: Enough! You disgrace both your sects.
Squabbling like children in front of the townsfolk?
Our sects' pact will not break because of you!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.g: Our sect will pay compensation.
Accept this as our sect's apology.
Our disciple was at fault. We bear the cost.
May this be enough to close today's wound.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.k: So this is what you do behind the sect's back?!
A disciple of the enemy?! Have you lost your mind?
The Grand Elder will hear of this!
Let go of that hand! Home, now!
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.d: From today on, we are enemies no more.
Agreed. May we meet again as friends.
You're an honourable rival. Forgive what I said.
I was stubborn too. Let's forget it all.
The tea at that house is on me this time.
Fine. Just no more broken cups.
Your master raised you well.
Your sect has good people too, it seems.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.s: We'll see. I'll be waiting on the stage.
Don't lose to anyone else before we meet again.
Your sword makes me want to train harder.
Good. I don't like weak rivals.
You're the only one worthy of being my rival.
An honour. Until the next tournament.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.seteru.naskah.k: Even if our sects are enemies... I still choose you.
And I choose you, whatever the elders say.
Just a moment. I missed your voice.
I brought a mooncake from town. For you.
Keep this red string, so you remember me.
One day we won't have to hide anymore.
I'll wait for that day, however long it takes.
